name: travel-planner
description: Travel planner: Angular frontend + Express/TypeScript backend on Firebase

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,hosting
